items.title: US strikes Iran after attack on cargo ship
items.description: Iran accuses the US of violating their deal and says it struck targets linked to American forces in response.

items.title: Venezuela earthquakes kill 920 people as international rescue teams arrive
items.description: Hundreds are still feared trapped under the rubble, as families desperate for news.

items.title: Mother dies saving daughter in Venezuela earthquakes
items.description: Héctor Bello wrote on social media that "you gave your own life for our daughter" in the quakes which killed at least 920 people.

items.title: Meloni and Trump: A very public fall-out that is proving very hard to fix
items.description: Italy's PM was not long ago being called the "Trump whisperer", but their relationship has gone from public attacks to personal insults.

items.title: Europe's deadly heatwave breaks German record and halts public events
items.description: Germany's highest ever temperature of 41.3C is recorded provisionally in Saarbrücken, over the border from France.

items.title: Religion row as Texas makes Bible stories required reading in schools
items.description: Critics say the new reading requirements infringe on religious freedoms and blur the separation of church and state.

items.title: DR Congo takes Rwanda to international court over decades of conflict
items.description: Kinshasa accuses its neighbour of committing various violations since the 1994 Rwanda genocide.

items.title: Israel and Lebanon sign framework agreement after US-brokered talks
items.description: Hezbollah is not party to Friday's agreement, and previous ceasefires between Israel and Lebanon have still seen near-daily cross-border strikes.

items.title: Ex-Trump adviser John Bolton pleads guilty to mishandling classified documents
items.description: Bolton faces a prison sentence of up to five years and has agreed to pay $2.25m in fine, prosecutors say.

items.title: Christmas market attacker jailed for life for murdering six in Germany
items.description: A nine-year-old and five women were killed when Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen drove into the market in 2024.

items.title: Senior Ukrainian intelligence official jailed for life for spying for Russia
items.description: Col Dmytro Kozyura agreed to share state secrets and systematically disclosed classified information, prosecutors say.

items.title: Four men held over child marriage in Sierra Leone appear in landmark court case
items.description: It relates to a 17-year-old girl - four men including her father and husband face years in jail if convicted.
